notes.title: July 9 Update – Bug Fixes
notes.content:
**July 9 Update – Bug Fixes**

Hi everyone! Thanks again for your support and feedback on *Echoveil: The Last Guest*. This update brings highly requested features and important fixes:



 **Bug Fixes**

- Fixed bug where player could get stuck behind the cabinet in the laundry room

- Fixed starting area progression glitch

- Added *subtitles for voice-overs* for better accessibility



Thanks again for playing! If you encounter more issues or want to share suggestions, feel free to post on the Steam forums. Your feedback means a lot! 

– Praveen Raj (Developer Of Echoveil The Last Guest)
